entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I... I have an order. I bought a jersey a while ago and it just doesn't fit. I'm a bit lost on what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Mark Sterling. Order number... uh... hold on... 774-B-91. I think.
Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling that up now... I see the Pro-Line Aero Jersey, delivered about 53 days ago. What specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is there a defect or is it a preference issue?
It's just the wrong size. It's way too tight in the shoulders. I was hoping to do an exchange for a large, but the website was so confusing. All these different policies... Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can clarify that for you. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for this item. One moment.

Okay, I've confirmed it. Because your jersey is one of our standard apparel items, it falls under our 90-day return policy. Since you received it 53 days ago, you're well within the window for an exchange or a full refund.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! So I can send it back?
Absolutely. I can process that exchange for the larger size right now and email you a prepaid return label for the jersey that was too tight. Would you like me to do that?
Yes, please! That would be perfect. Thank you so much, Diana. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome, Mark. The return label is on its way to your email now. Once we receive the original item, we'll ship out the new size. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
